content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Vested, Inc.: Senior Software Engineer Anywhere in the World 🇺🇸 United States of America Florida MongoDB, Node.js, React, and TypeScript Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/1089/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://vested.co">https://vested.co</a> </p> <h2><strong>About the role<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <p>We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can define and deliver products that have a real impact on people's financial futures. You'll be joining a small and early-stage engineering team where each engineer has significant ownership and your contributions will directly shape the product and the company's technical direction.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>As a senior member of our engineering team, you'll focus on the development and supporting infrastructure of vested.co – our core equity management and stock-option-funding platform.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build impactful features</strong>: Design and implement user-facing features that help people understand and manage their equity compensation.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Own end-to-end delivery</strong>: Take projects from concept to production, including system design, implementation, testing, and deployment.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Shape our technical direction</strong>: Contribute to architectural decisions and help establish engineering best practices as we scale.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Collaborate cross-functionally</strong>: Work closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver exceptional user experiences.</li> <li><strong>Grow the team</strong>: Share your expertise with other engineers and help build a culture of continuous learning. Help us grow and shape our inclusive, friendly, egoless engineering culture.</li> <li><strong>Solve complex problems</strong>: Tackle challenging technical problems around financial calculations, data integrations, and building reliable systems at scale.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>4+ years of software engineering experience </strong>with a track record of shipping production software.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Full-stack capabilities </strong>with strong expertise in modern web technologies. We work with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB. You should be experienced building frontend features, designing APIs, and modeling data relationships.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Product mindset</strong>: You care deeply about user experience and enjoy building products that solve real problems.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Strong communication skills</strong>: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Ownership mentality</strong>: You take pride in your work and see projects through from start to finish.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><strong>Growth mindset</strong>: Eager to learn new technologies and domains.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <ul> <li>Meaningful equity, with industry-leading grant terms (naturally)<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Market competitive salary<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>95% paid health insurance for employees and dependents<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>401k match<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Fully remote, distributed workplace<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Generous time away including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Quarterly team offsites throughout the country<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <p>Expected salary for this role is $145,000 - $190,000 (depending on qualifications and experience)<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <h2><strong>Location<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <p>Fully remote. Standup and collaboration is centered mostly around the Eastern Time Zone, but we have team members from Alaska to Europe.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <h2><strong>Ready to Join Us?<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <p>If you're excited about making equity ownership accessible to everyone and want to work on challenging technical problems with a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Our interview process will include an initial meeting to assess mutual interest, a live technical interview, and further opportunities to meet the team and discuss your background.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Please send a brief note expressing your interest as well as your resume to engineering@vested.co with the subject “Senior Software Engineer Application.”<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <p><em>Vested </em><em>is an equal opportunity employer and considers all quali</em>fi<em>ed applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></em></p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vested-inc-senior-software-engineer-1">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vested-inc-senior-software-engineer-1</a></p> Mon, 26 Oct 2026 20:12:46 +0000 Wed, 25 Nov 2026 20:12:46 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vested-inc-senior-software-engineer-1 https://weworkremotely.com/remote
